title: ObjectUserBody and NodeUser: the user functions get the displacement coordinates q, not the total coordinates
author: Claude-JG
description: Q of the user functions of ObjectUserBody and NodeUser is the displacement coordinates, as inside the C++ items, so that the results are comparable; a finite element computes with the displacements and its reference geometry from qRef, a rigid body with qRef + q. The C++ gathers q without the reference values (also for the graphicsDataUserFunction), CNodeUser::Displacements replaces TotalCoordinates; the descriptions, the mini examples and the test models with user items are changed accordingly, their results unchanged.
releaseNotes: The user functions of ObjectUserBody and NodeUser get the displacement coordinates q, as the C++ items compute with them; the total coordinates are qRef + q
